text: Lesson 11.
Not guilty.
What was the Customs
Officer looking for?
Customs Officers are quite tolerant these days,
zh: 如今海关官员相当宽容，
zh_hant: 如今海關官員相當寬容，

text: but they can still stop you when you are going through the Green Channel and have nothing to declare.
zh: 但当你走绿色通道且无物可申报时，他们仍可能拦下你。
zh_hant: 但當你走綠色通道且無物可申報時，他們仍可能攔下你。

text: Even really honest people are often made to feel guilty.
zh: 即使非常诚实的人也常被弄得感到内疚。
zh_hant: 即使非常誠實的人也常被弄得感到內疚。

text: The hardened professional smuggler, on the other hand, is never troubled by such feelings,
zh: 另一方面，老练的职业走私犯却从不为这种感受所困扰，
zh_hant: 另一方面，老練的職業走私犯卻從不為這種感受所困擾，

text: even if he has five hundred gold watches hidden in his suitcase.
zh: 即使他箱子里藏着五百块金表。
zh_hant: 即使他箱子裡藏著五百塊金錶。

text: When I returned from abroad recently,
a particularly officious young Customs Officer clearly regarded me as a smuggler.
zh: 一位特别爱管闲事的年轻海关官员显然把我当成了走私犯。
zh_hant: 一位特別愛管閒事的年輕海關官員顯然把我當成了走私犯。

text: 'Have you anything to declare?'
he asked, looking me in the eye.
'No,' I answered confidently.
'Would you mind unlocking this suitcase please?
' 'Not at all,' I answered.
The Officer went through the case with great care.
zh: 那位官员非常仔细地检查了箱子。
zh_hant: 那位官員非常仔細地檢查了箱子。

text: All the things I had packed so carefully were soon in a dreadful mess.
zh: 我精心打包的所有东西很快乱成一团。
zh_hant: 我精心打包的所有東西很快亂成一團。

text: I felt sure I would never be able to close the case again.
zh: 我确信自己再也无法把箱子合上了。
zh_hant: 我確信自己再也無法把箱子合上了。

text: Suddenly, I saw the Officer's face light up.
zh: 突然，我看到那位官员的脸亮了起来。
zh_hant: 突然，我看到那位官員的臉亮了起來。

text: He had spotted a tiny bottle at the bottom of my case and he pounced on it with delight.
zh: 他发现了箱子底部的一个小瓶子，并欣喜地扑了上去。
zh_hant: 他發現了箱子底部的一個小瓶子，並欣喜地撲了上去。

text: 'Perfume, eh?'
he asked sarcastically.
'You should have declared that.
Perfume is not exempt from import duty.
' 'But it isn't perfume, I said.
'It's hair gel.
' Then I added with a smile, 'It's a strange mixture
zh: ”然后我微笑着补充说，“这是我自制的一种奇怪混合物
zh_hant: ”然後我微笑著補充說，“這是我自制的一種奇怪混合物

text: I make myself.
As I expected, he did not believe me.
zh: 不出我所料，他不相信我。
zh_hant: 不出我所料，他不相信我。

text: 'Try it!'
I said encouragingly.
The Officer unscrewed the cap and put the bottle to his nostrils.
zh: 那位官员拧开瓶盖，把瓶子凑到鼻孔前。
zh_hant: 那位官員擰開瓶蓋，把瓶子湊到鼻孔前。

text: He was greeted by an unpleasant smell which convinced him that I was telling the truth.
zh: 一股难闻的气味迎面而来，使他确信我说的是实话。
zh_hant: 一股難聞的氣味迎面而來，使他確信我說的是實話。

text: A few minutes later, I was able to hurry away with precious chalk marks on my baggage.
zh: 几分钟后，我得以带着行李上宝贵的粉笔记号匆匆离开。
zh_hant: 幾分鐘後，我得以帶著行李上寶貴的粉筆記號匆匆離開。
